snippet.title: Gameplay Malasombra for Nes
snippet.description:
Malasombra for NES — a game with great attention to graphics and sound, well-crafted animations, and an interesting story and gameplay. It has only one flaw… it’s damn hard.
Perfect for those looking for a tough challenge.
Have you tried it? What do you think.  Easy or hard?
Let us know in the comments!

ps: Get ready  with every Game Over, you’ll be swearing like never before! :)

Podcast: https://www.newgameoldflame.com/
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/AP2p4dZCUe
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/NewGameOldFlame
